## 简体中文

- 新增 GPU 使用者显示：从 GPU 进程 PID 读取用户名，过滤 Xorg，同一用户只显示一次；PID 最大的用户排在最前，其他用户通过 `+N` 和悬停自定义列表查看。
- 新增 GPU 进程详情：点击显卡卡片查看 PID、进程名、用户、运行时长、显存占用和进程类型，跟随 GPU 检测间隔刷新，并支持手动刷新。
- 支持结束自己的 GPU 进程：确认框提供取消、正常结束和强制结束；后台再次核对归属和进程身份，仅操作选中 PID。明确提示：如果作业由 Slurm 提交，结束进程不会主动取消作业。
- 优化进程面板交互：高斯模糊展开，点击关闭按钮高斯模糊收回；点击空白处使用边缘光点消散，中央表格渐进模糊、周围光点保持清晰。适配深浅主题文字颜色，保留滚动条占位，支持减少动态效果。
- 更新中英文使用说明。继续保留 v1.10.6 的 macOS 原生 WebView 启动修复、完整应用临时签名，以及 Apple Silicon / Intel 的签名和打包应用启动检查；检查失败会阻止发布为 Latest。

macOS 发行包继续使用完整临时签名，尚未使用 Developer ID 签名或通过 Apple 公证。

## English

- Show GPU process owners: resolve usernames from GPU PIDs, exclude Xorg, and deduplicate users. The user with the highest PID appears first; a `+N` badge opens a custom hover list containing only the other users.
- Add per-GPU process details with PID, process name, user, elapsed time, GPU memory and process type. Refresh follows GPU monitoring and can also be triggered manually.
- Allow stopping your own GPU processes after choosing Cancel, Terminate or Force stop. The backend rechecks ownership and process identity and signals only the selected PID. The confirmation explains that ending a process does not actively cancel a Slurm job that launched it.
- Refine the process panel: Gaussian blur expansion and return on the close button; clicking outside dissolves the edges into particles while progressively blurring the remaining table and keeping particles sharp. Text follows the app theme, scrollbar space stays reserved, and reduced-motion preferences are respected.
- Update the Chinese and English documentation. Retain the v1.10.6 macOS native WebView startup fix, full ad-hoc application signing, and signature / packaged-app startup checks for Apple Silicon and Intel. Failed checks block publication as Latest.

macOS packages continue to use full ad-hoc signing without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization.
